metadata.description: A collection of Claude skills and plugins by Eduardo Schroder.

plugins.name: commit-message
plugins.description: Generates semantic git commit messages based on staged changes

plugins.name: versioning
plugins.description: Automated semantic versioning via release.mjs — reads commit history, bumps MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH, updates package.json, and creates a release commit + git tag

plugins.name: vue-style-guide
plugins.description: Enforces the official Vue.js style guide for naming and structuring Vue components, composables, and code, organized by priority

plugins.name: vue-ts-style-guide
plugins.description: Enforces Vue 3 + TypeScript Composition API conventions — typed props, emits, refs, reactive state, event handlers, provide/inject, and custom directives

plugins.name: vue-project-setup
plugins.description: Scaffolds a new Vue 3 project with TypeScript, JSX, Router, Pinia, Playwright, ESLint, and Prettier, then installs the companion style-guide and api-client-conventions plugins

plugins.name: pinia-style-guide
plugins.description: Enforces conventions for writing Pinia stores with the Composition API — naming, typed state, async actions, getters, persistence, and testing

plugins.name: vue-i18n
plugins.description: Enforces internationalization best practices in Vue.js + vue-i18n projects, fully compatible with the i18n Ally VS Code extension

plugins.name: vue-scss-setup
plugins.description: Configures Sass/SCSS in a Vue 3 + Vite project — installs sass-embedded, creates global variable and mixin partials, and wires them into every component via vite.config.ts additionalData

plugins.name: api-client-conventions
plugins.description: Style guide for structuring API calls and services — typed axios/fetch wrapper, error normalisation, service modules, and Vue 3 composables

plugins.name: testing-conventions
plugins.description: House style guide for Vitest unit/component tests and Playwright e2e tests — file layout, naming, Page Object Models, mocking, and auth fixtures for Vue 3 + TypeScript projects.

plugins.name: env-validation
plugins.description: Enforces .env schema validation with Zod — single typed gateway file, fail-fast startup, .env.example parity, and Vitest-safe stubs for Vue/Vite and Node projects

plugins.name: vue-component-docs
plugins.description: Documents Vue 3 reusable components with JSDoc-style comments and generates a live Vue Styleguidist site powered by vue-docgen-api

plugins.name: element-plus-setup
plugins.description: Installs and configures Element Plus in a Vue 3 + Vite project — sets up auto-import, enables optional dark mode via VueUse useDark with moon/sun toggle, aligns theming with existing SCSS variables or Element Plus defaults, optionally installs the icons package, and scaffolds an optional app structure with auth pages and a chosen navigation layout using the project folder name as the brand

plugins.name: firebase-setup
plugins.description: Installs and configures Firebase in any TypeScript project — asks which services to enable (Firestore, Authentication, Realtime Database, Storage, Functions, Hosting), scaffolds typed service modules, and wires Firebase config through environment variables
